nodes.name: When clicking ‘Execute workflow’
nodes.notes: Run this manually whenever you want to organise your inbox. Triggers the full pipeline on demand.

nodes.name: Loop Over Items
nodes.notes: Iterates through each domain group one at a time. Batch size 1 ensures folders are created and emails moved cleanly before moving to the next group.

nodes.name: Code1
nodes.notes:
IMAP fetch code

Connects to the mail server via IMAP and fetches the 50 most recent emails from INBOX. Returns uid, from, subject and date for each email. Increase slice size once tested.

nodes.name: Code2
nodes.notes: Extract Code: Extracts the sender domain from the From header of each email. e.g. newsletter@amazon.es becomes amazon.es. Adds a domain field to each item.

nodes.name: Code3
nodes.notes: Gropuing Code: Groups all emails by sender domain into a map of { domain, uids }. One item per domain group is output, ready for the loop.

nodes.name: Code4
nodes.notes:
Create Email Folder



Creates an IMAP subfolder under Organised/ for the current domain group if it does not already exist. e.g. Organised/amazon.es

nodes.name: Code5
nodes.notes: Move Emails + Delete: Moves all emails belonging to the current domain group from INBOX into its Organised/ subfolder. Falls back to COPY + DELETE if the mail server does not support MOVE.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Reads IMAP credentials from n8n environment variables (IMAP_USER, IMAP_PASSWORD, IMAP_HOST) rather than hardcoding them in code. Set these in your .env file or hosting panel.
